query: select e.id as exam_id, u.slug, r.state as review_state, r.body->'runtimeApproval'->>'status' as runtime_approval_status, coalesce(jsonb_array_length(r.body->'package'->'questions'),0) as reviewed_package_question_count, r.body->'runtimeApproval'->'question_ids' as approved_question_ids from public.essay_exams e join public.universities u on u.id=e.university_id left join essay_material_private.reviews r on r.exam_id=e.id where coalesce(e.field_or_division,'') ~ '자연|수리|이학|공학|의예|약학|수학|물리|화학|생명과학|지구과학' order by u.slug,e.id
